trigger.finding: MVP1 leaf is proven, but the execution-local transition table permits PREDICATE_VERIFIED only in VERIFYING/VERIFIED. Advancing the parent MVP1-MVP8 Work Order to either state would prevent legal continuation to later MVP leaves.

root_cause: The parent Work Order intentionally spans MVP1 through MVP8, while its execution-local transition table was written for terminal predicate verification semantics. The reducer already tracks completed predicates independently from state, so MVP leaf closure needs an execution-local non-terminal PREDICATE_VERIFIED self-transition in IN_PROGRESS rather than a global Harness change.
canonical_fix_owner: Only the E2026-09-09-V0-MVP-R1 execution-local transition table. Do not modify global Harness reducer semantics or product runtime.
forbidden_changes: Existing MVP events 1-5, Work Order snapshot, epoch, acceptance and audit records
Runtime, scenes, product tests, Matter, Item Graph, persistence, network, SM1, P7 and project.godot
Registry, architecture ownership and canonical main state
repair: Allow event_type=PREDICATE_VERIFIED with work_state=IN_PROGRESS only through this execution-local transition table.
Keep IN_PROGRESS->IN_PROGRESS as the parent state transition; the reducer records the leaf predicate in completed_predicates without terminalizing the parent Work Order.
Prove a subsequent IMPLEMENTATION_COMMITTED/IN_PROGRESS event remains legal, preserving the route to MVP2 and later leaves.
Prove attempting to jump from current IN_PROGRESS directly to VERIFIED remains rejected.
Do not create the real MVP1 PREDICATE_VERIFIED event until R13 itself passes focused/full Harness and review.
authority_boundary: R13 changes only execution-local state-machine semantics for partial leaf completion. It does not itself verify MVP1, merge runtime, accept the whole MVP, authorize MVP2 evidence, or change any global Harness contract.
